text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#INC-8241 for service=hosted-inference-prod-01 — high error rate (5xx) and latency spike. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8241

incident-bot: Escalation policy=prod-l1 -> primary on-call @sanjay, timeout=5m

sanjay: ack'd. I'm on it. pulling runbook now. :eyes:

laura: ping — affected customers? any downstream failures?

sanjay: early look: spike in 5xx from model-servers hitting cache store (kv-cache) timeouts. will grab logs and metrics.

kevin: I see the same in grafana: tail latency jumped to ~1.3s and error rate 12% starting 09:12 UTC.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: primary acknowledged at 1769994460 by sanjay.

oncall-rotation: quick heads-up, @sanjay, your mobile shows you as DND? check you got the full PD details.

sanjay: got it. I'm SSHing into the routing host now. running `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-server --tail=200` to confirm.

sanjay: logs show repeated timeout to kv-cache: `ERROR: kv_store: request timeout after 500ms` repeated across pods.

laura: is kv-cache a managed service? who owns it? @kevin?

kevin: infra owns the cache. paging infra on-call. I'm posting their PD link into the ticket.

incident-bot: Alert: secondary escalation scheduled in 4m if no acknowledgment from infra-oncall.

sanjay: mitigation attempt: rolling restart one model-server pod to recover connection. patching config to increase client socket timeout to 1s as temporary.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: infra-oncall notified for service=kv-cache-prod (PD#INFRA-309). Escalation window 4m.

kevin: infra-oncall didn't ack within window, PD escalated to secondary and then manager.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary and manager paged after missed ack. manager-ops has been paged.

manager-ops: I'm awake, joining. can someone paste the most recent manifests and the `kubectl get pods` output?

alex: `kubectl get pods -n inference` output: model-server-0 Ready 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff, model-server-1 Ready 1/1, kv-cache-0 Ready 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff, kv-cache-1 Ready 1/1

laura: customer impact: some inference requests timing out, autoscale not keeping up because requests are blocking on cache layer. user-facing error rate equals 0.8% of total traffic (approx 6 customers see degraded experience).

sanjay: rolling restart of kv-cache-0 succeeded, but kv-cache-0 immediately hit same socket timeout. suspect upstream network flaps to the cache cluster or file descriptor exhaustion. collecting `ss -s` and `dmesg` from hosts.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: manager-ops acknowledged at 1769994565. Manager is on the bridge.

manager-ops: joining bridge. @sanjay @kevin runbook step 3 says to failover to cache-replica set. Can infra perform failover?

kevin: infra says replica set is healthy but currently has cross-region replication lag. failover might cause higher latency but reduce errors. proposing to promote replica in same region as model-serving to avoid network hops. :thumbsup:

laura: recommend notifying affected customers via status page and set ETA for mitigation.

sanjay: implementing traffic reroute to bypass cache for reads with a short TTL (400ms) for 10m window: setting feature-flag `cache_bypass=read_short_ttl` on routing layer.

alex: applied feature-flag, pushing config: ```
POST /config/feature-flags
{"cache_bypass":"read_short_ttl","expires":"10m"}
```

incident-bot: Automation note: feature flag deploy finished at 1769994590 by alex.

kevin: after bypass, 5xxs dropped to 1.5% and tail latency down to 650ms. still elevated but moving in right direction.

laura: I've drafted the status page update and DMing customer success for outbound comms.

manager-ops: good mitigation. infra to perform controlled promotion of local replica; monitor for replication issues. keep paged if anything regresses.

sanjay: monitoring logs and traces. will keep thread updated. thanks team.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by primary and manager; escalation chain completed. If no further regressions in 30m, incident will be marked resolved. :white_check_mark:

laura: follow-up tasks: postmortem owner (sanjay), infra root-cause (kevin), customer comms (laura). I'll create the incident doc after stabilization.

sanjay: assigning and putting initial notes in the incident tracker. link: https://incidents.example/INC-8241

kevin: adding runbook gaps: need clearer failover play for kv-cache and better alert thresholds for replication lag.

incident-bot: Incident closed (automated) at 1769994620 after 30m no regressions.

laura: thanks everyone. :heart:
